bases.but: Know what wins games, what kills you, and pick your hero.

lane.but: Win your first 8 minutes on souls, not kills.

depenser.but: Turn your souls and points into power, right away.

survivre.but: Die less, and never for nothing.

carte.but: Read the minimap and take what the map gives you.

macro.but: Know where to go once laning ends, and take objectives down.

combat.but: Deal more damage with the same bullets.
